J Am Coll Cardiol 2002; 40: 491–8. Hypotension. Beta blockers have a hypotensive effect and are usually used to reduce blood pressure in patients with hyperten- sion, or occasionally to produce controlled hypotension during surgery. Paradoxically, however, they may be used in the man- agement of neurally mediated hypotension in patients who re- quire drug therapy (see p.1174), although there is limited evi- dence to support their use, and adverse effects may be a concern.
